Name: Only Entities
Description: Only import the entities from the VMF. Brushes and internal entities are not modified. Conserves existing lighting data.

Name: Only Props
Description: Only update static and detail props (i.e. the internal entities).
Warning: Does not generate a .prt file, making VVIS fail!

Name: No Detail
Description: Compiles without func_detail brushes.

Name: No T-Junc
Description: Don't fixup any t-junctions.

Name: Nodraw triggers
Description: Treat trigger faces as if they were textured with nodraw, saving a small amount of lightmap space at the expense of debugability.
Warning: Only affects triggers using %compiletrigger. Func_occluders should use toolsoccluder instead of toolstrigger, to avoid issues.

Name: Allow Detail Cracks
Description: Don't fixup t-junctions on func_detail.

Name: No Water
Description: Compiles without water brushes.

Name: Leak Test
Description: Stop compiling if a leak is detected.

Name: Micro Volume Test
Description: VBSP will warn when brushes are output with a volume less than this number (default: 1.0).

Name: All Detail
Description: Make all geometry func_detail to improve VVIS times. Use with a radius override of 2500 in VVIS.
Warning: Support varies between versions of source.

Name: Full Detail
Description: Mark all detail geometry as normal geometry (so all detail geometry will affect visibility).

Name: Normal Priority
Description: Run process with a normal process priority (be default below normal). Will prevent process from getting run on an efficiency core for certain CPUs
Warning: Using above normal process priority can cause other applications to become slow/unresponsive

Name: Verbose
Description: Turn on verbose output for debug purposes.

Name: Static Prop Combine
Description: Merges static props together according to the rules defined in scripts/hammer/spcombinerules/spcombinerules.txt.

Name: Static Prop Combine - Keep Sources
Description: Don't clean up cluster models after bspzip.

Name: Static Prop Combine - Consider VIS
Description: Cluster static prop models only within vis clusters.

Name: Static Prop Combine - Autocombine
Description: Automatically combine simple static props without an explicit combine rule.

Name: Static Prop Combine - Suggest Rules
Description: Suggest rules to add to spcombinerules.txt

Name: Static Prop Combine - Min Instances
Description: Set the minimum number of props in a combine group required to create a combined prop.

Name: Static Prop Combine - Print Combine Rules
Description: Prints the combine rules

Name: Static Prop Combine - Color Instances
Description: Instances of combined props get colored

Name: Static Prop Combine Ignore - Fast Reflection
Description: Combine props, even if they have differing Render in Fast Reflections settings.

Name: Static Prop Combine Ignore - Normals
Description: Combine props, even if they have differing Ignore Normals settings.

Name: Static Prop Combine Ignore - No Shadow
Description: Combine props, even if they have differing Disable Shadows settings.

Name: Static Prop Combine Ignore - No Vertex Lighting
Description: Combine props, even if they have differing Disable Vertex lighting settings.

Name: Static Prop Combine Ignore - No Flashlight
Description: Combine props, even if they have differing Disable flashlight settings.

Name: Static Prop Combine Ignore - No Self Shadowing
Description: Combine props, even if they have differing Disable Self-Shadowing settings.

Name: Static Prop Combine Ignore - Disable Shadow Depth
Description: Combine props, even if they have differing Disable ShadowDepth settings.

Name: Allow Dynamic Props As Static
Description: Allow all models with the 'static' flag in the model viewer to be used on prop_static, even when their propdata doesn't contain 'allowstatic'.

Name: Cull Brushes
Description: Reduces brush count even when the brush limit has not been exceeded. VBSP++ does this on its own once the limit is reached; this makes it unconditional.

Name: Cull Brush Sides
Description: Reduces brushside count even when the brushside limit has not been exceeded.

Name: Cull Planes
Description: Reduces plane count even when the plane limit has not been exceeded.

Name: No Cull
Description: Turns off every form of reduction - brushes, brushsides, vertexes and planes are all written as authored.
Warning: A map that needed culling to fit under a limit will fail to compile instead

Name: Cull Verts
Description: Reduces vertex count even when the vertex limit has not been exceeded.

Name: No Leak Test
Description: Disables leak testing. tools++ enables leak testing by default, this turns it back off.

Name: Block Size
Description: Size of the blocks visibility is computed in. Default 1024.

Name: No Bevel
Description: Disables generation of extra brushsides for angled geometry.

Name: No Name Fixup
Description: Disables prefixing of entity names inside func_instance.

Name: Warn Missing Instances
Description: Warns about missing instance VMFs instead of aborting the compile.

Name: Missing Material
Description: Replaces missing brush materials with the named material instead of failing.

Name: Force Material
Description: Replaces every brush material with the named material. Useful for greybox lighting tests.

Name: Entity First
Description: Forces the given entity classname to be sorted first in the entity lump.

Name: Max Brushes
Description: Raises the brush limit above the engine default.
Warning: Exceeding engine limits can produce a map the game cannot load

Name: Max Brush Sides
Description: Raises the brushside limit above the engine default.
Warning: Exceeding engine limits can produce a map the game cannot load

Name: Max Dispinfo
Description: Raises the displacement limit above the engine default.
Warning: Exceeding engine limits can produce a map the game cannot load

Name: Max Texinfo
Description: Raises the texinfo limit above the engine default.
Warning: Exceeding engine limits can produce a map the game cannot load

Name: Max Lightmap Dimension
Description: Maximum lightmap dimension allowed on a single face.

Name: Default Luxel Size
Description: Default luxel size applied to faces that do not specify one.

Name: Max Luxel Scale
Description: Clamps the maximum luxel scale, preventing extremely coarse lightmaps.

Name: No HDR Cubemap
Description: Excludes HDR cubemaps from the BSP, reducing file size.

Name: No LDR Cubemap
Description: Excludes LDR cubemaps from the BSP, reducing file size.

Name: No Default Cubemap
Description: Excludes both HDR and LDR default cubemaps from the BSP.

Name: No Bump
Description: Disables bumpmapped lightmaps, shrinking the lightmap data considerably.
Warning: Bumpmapped materials will lose their directional lighting

Name: Static Prop Format
Description: Forces a specific static prop lump version (v6 to v14). Use when a game expects a particular format.

Name: Simple Ladders
Description: Compiles ladders in the func_simpleladder format.

Name: Report Search Paths
Description: Prints the content search paths VBSP is using. Useful for diagnosing missing assets.

Name: Show Ineligible Vertex Lit Props
Description: Lists props that were excluded from the vertex lighting optimisation.

Name: No Ineligible Vertex Lit Props
Description: Disables the vertex lighting optimisation for props entirely.

Name: BSP Format: Singleplayer
Description: Compiles the BSP in the HL2 / SDK 2013 singleplayer format.
Warning: Only set this if the target game needs a non default BSP format

Name: BSP Format: Left 4 Dead 2
Description: Compiles the BSP in the Left 4 Dead 2 format.
Warning: Only set this if the target game needs a non default BSP format

Name: BSP Format: Portal 2
Description: Compiles the BSP in the Portal 2 format.
Warning: Only set this if the target game needs a non default BSP format

Name: BSP Format: Alien Swarm
Description: Compiles the BSP in the Alien Swarm format.
Warning: Only set this if the target game needs a non default BSP format

Name: BSP Format: CS:GO
Description: Compiles the BSP in the Counter-Strike: Global Offensive format.
Warning: Only set this if the target game needs a non default BSP format
